Team — quick heads up for today’s commit sprint (closing window for Q3 motion). Key asks below; please read and act before the 5 PM PT submission: 

1) Update HubSpot stages by 5 PM PT (today). 
   - Move any deals you intend to "Commit" to Stage: Contract Sent or Legal Review (see mapping below). 
   - Mark "Best Case" deals as Opportunity/Negotiation.

2) Fill the attached forecast_template_v2.xlsx with: ARR, Owner, Expected Close Date, Commit? (Y/N), Confidence %, Primary Risk

3) Upload the commit_tracker.csv to the shared Drive folder and add one-line rationale for any deal moving into Commit.

4) Pre-call (tomorrow 10:00 AM PT) agenda: 10m quick pipeline triage, 15m top-5 deal call-outs, 20m blockers & legal/procurement flags, 15m action assignment. Invite sent — please accept.

Stage mapping (use this consistently):
- Commit: Contract Sent | Legal Review (only when contract engaged or active SOW)
- Best Case: Negotiation | Presented
- Pipeline: Qualification | Demo Scheduled

If you have >1 deal moving to Commit, add a short note in the commit_tracker.csv explaining remaining conditions (PO, signature date, procurement acceptance). I’ll be triaging with RevOps at 4:30 PM PT.

Attachments: forecast_template_v2.xlsx, commit_tracker.csv

Thanks — let’s keep the window clean.
